name: Cybersecurity Research
description: Hardware resource policy for VM/container-heavy security research workloads: the same conservative, evidence-based CPU/memory/storage policy as 'balanced', biased for stable virtualization behavior rather than AI-style peak compute. This is resource policy only — the actual isolated security tooling/VM images (S5 scope, ADR-0004) are separate, unimplemented future work. No networking or security configuration is touched in S2. See docs/hardware/architecture.md.
